tools.name: getDrillDetails
tools.description: Get the full details of a SoccerXpert soccer drill by its URL slug (e.g. "4-corners-shooting"). Returns name, description, setup image, step-by-step instructions, categories, and age groups as JSON.

slug.description: The drill URL slug, from searchDrills results or a /drills/details/{slug} URL.

tools.name: listDrillCategories
tools.description: List all SoccerXpert drill categories (drill types), age groups, and their browse-page URLs. Use the returned names as searchDrills filters.

tools.name: searchDrills
tools.description: Search SoccerXpert soccer drills by keyword, drill type, and/or age group. Returns a JSON list of matching drills with name, URL slug, objective, and metadata. Use getDrillDetails with a returned slug for full instructions.

query.description: Keyword(s) to search drill names and descriptions for, e.g. "passing square".

drillType.description: Optional drill type filter. One of: Dribbling, Passing, Receiving / Turning, Heading, Crossing/Finishing, Fitness, Possession, Defending, Attacking, Shooting, Goalkeeping, Warm-Up, Fun.

ageGroup.description: Optional age group filter. One of: u6-u8, u10-u12, u14-u16, u17+.

page.description: Result page number, starting at 1 (12 drills per page).
